intro.title: Explore our service and book according to your need.

features.title: Healings
features.body: Healing sessions chosen by the modality and by what you are actually carrying. The sitting can be in Dehradun or at a distance.

features.title: Ritual Castings
features.body: Candle rituals set around the matter you bring, whether that is healing, a relation, protection, a clearing, love, or a blessing.

features.title: Akashic Records
features.body: A sitting in the Akashic records, used to see the thread of a life and what is asking to be understood now.

features.title: PLR (Past Life Regression) Therapy
features.body: A guided regression sitting, used when a present matter seems older than this life.

features.title: Hoodoo
features.body: Seeking help with Saints and spirits. The working is set around the matter you bring.
features.imageAlt: A candle and figure prepared for spirit work

features.title: Divinations
features.body: A reading to see what is present and what is pressing, so the next choice is easier to see.
features.imageAlt: Cards laid out for a reading

features.title: Meditations
features.body: A guided sitting, meant to settle attention and lift it toward the part of you that already knows the way.
